description: DNS lookup, DNS records (A, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME) for any domain. Look up DNS records for a domain: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA, SRV or all the common ones at once (type=ALL). Uses Cloudflare's public 1.1.1.1 resolver over HTTPS. Returns each record with its TTL. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
